title: Sum of shifted multiplication rows
statement: For Boolean lists $a,b$ and natural numbers $j,p$, define the sum of shifted rows by summing, over $q$ from $0$ to $|a|-1$, the row sum with Boolean entry $a_q$, list $b$, column index $j$, and shift $p+q$; entries of $a$ beyond its length are interpreted as false.
